title: Independent verification: R439 frame-509 matrix replay (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

Independent finite verification of the local R439 frame-509 matrix claim in #1221. No new circuit, supplier adoption, kappa, or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Result

- A code-disjoint row-bitset replay gives the same GF(2) map for the pinned 21-ADD PR973 block and 20-ADD PR1221 block over all 11 local registers.
- An integer coefficient-vector replay gives `Z(PR973) - Z(PR1221) = 2 e_468 e_33^T` exactly.
- Rebuilding both splices from the pinned selected word reproduces the 24,305 / 24,285 / 24,283 complete ADD invoices and all 661 ordered frame paths. All source word fields outside B/C are unchanged.
- Reran #1221's verifier, all 10 package tests, and its C++ native checks under Linux x86_64, CPython 3.14.7, GCC 16.2.1 and Boost 1.92.0. The native replay passed the 883/1,327/1,549 column stages and 144 omitted-bridge controls.

The new package independently covers the local maps, splice, paths and invoices. H1-H5 and native obligations are from the pinned #1221 checker, rerun here; this package does not reprove them.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/seed18-r439-b509-independent-replay/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/seed18-r439-b509-independent-replay/test_audit.py -v
```

The additional #1221 replay commands and exact markers are recorded in `research/seed18-r439-b509-independent-replay/VALIDATION.json`.

## Provenance and overlap

Base commit: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Candidate #1221 head: `6deda901721316fcb61c6e2a6dd6b537de183452`; predecessor #973 head: `c05dc72734c25dd069077157224d4dd30c6e8c19`. #1221 remains open and has no recorded review at the last metadata refresh. This contribution adds a separate local matrix implementation and a second-host replay; it does not claim the circuit or ADD saving as new. #1311 addresses a different composed R439 word and semantic-D bridge.

Credit Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) for #1221, Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) for #973, and DreamingOfClouds' #589 on eumemic's #555 for the retained selected bit supplier. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed in `NOTICE.md`.
